Thank you for this opportunity to share my thoughts. I found Q3.4 about Absalon data challenging because tracking online activity feels intrusive. I chose "never" because I believe it infringes on student privacy.

The questions about sensitive data (Q3.5) were also difficult, especially concerning gender and disability. I think these should only be used if they significantly improve identification ("moderate").

For Q4.1, I prioritize explainability because students need to understand why they are being flagged for support. Moderate explanations seem sufficient.

The group's answers differed most on Q3.2 about course performance data. While many chose "small," I think a larger improvement is needed to justify its use. I wonder if an opt-out mechanism could help address concerns about privacy while still improving the model’s effectiveness.

Overall, I believe that the model should prioritize fairness and explainability over sheer accuracy.
